properties.description: There are bushes scattered around the parking lots.  I'm not sure how they've matured since I was last there but come at the right time and there should definitely be fruit.

properties.name: Black mulberry
properties.description: Pull into the back of the parking lot and stand on your car to harvest a ton of delicious black mulberries from the overhanging tree.

properties.name: Cherry plum
properties.description: All the streets in this valley are lined with wild cherry plums. But don't eat the ones off the trees with purple leaves. Poison.
properties.author: Strada

properties.name: Orange
properties.description: Really tasty and juicy seedless oranges that don't seem to be picked at all by the owner.  Part of the tree overhands the sidewalk and has easy-to-reach fruit.  FYI, a dog lives outside 24/7 on the other side of the fence.
properties.author: Becky

properties.name: Cherry
properties.description: Look like sweet cherries, not sure what kind. Fruiting well in early May. Probably will be ready in June.
properties.author: Caleb

properties.name: Apricot
properties.description: Two apricot trees in the backyard. Knock and ask to pick if you'd like some. Usually more than the house can use.
properties.author: Caleb

properties.name: Meyer lemon
properties.description: Three meyer lemon bushes in the backyard. A bit unhealthy so not fruiting hugely.
properties.author: Caleb

properties.name: Pecan
properties.description: The squirrels eat them all, but it's a proper hickory nut (Pecan).
